limitations: CPU emulation with synthetic account state, zero defense discount and one-level purchases; no live Android runtime.
Only allocation, GC write barrier, managed dictionary lookup and libc powf/modf are supplied; original game arithmetic and multiplier application execute.
Terminal zero is the existing SDK cap convention, not a native purchase at level 1800.
source: Original 29.1.3 APK ARM64 workshop coin-cost computation, replayed with Unicorn 2.1.4; input bytes matched to APK ZIP members
tableConvention: Row L buys level L+1; round returned native cost to whole coins; terminal zero retained at row 1800
cashConvention: Cash row L uses L in-run levels after subtracting permanent workshop levels. Row 1800 retains its calculated cash entry; the separate maximum-level check prevents purchase.
